description: This Python script is responsible for initializing and seeding a database for a video streaming platform. It defines functions to create or retrieve categories, users, and videos, and seeds the database with sample data including categories and sample videos. The main function 'init_db_and_seed' sets up the database schema, adds a demo user, and populates it with predefined categories and videos.

methods.name: Category _get_or_create_category(db: Session, name: str)
methods.description: Fetches an existing Category by name or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: User _get_or_create_user(db: Session, email: str, password_plain: str, full_name: str)
methods.description: Fetches an existing User by email or creates a new one with hashed password.

methods.name: Video _get_or_create_video( db: Session, title: str, description: str, thumbnail_url: str, video_url: str, categories: List[Category], )
methods.description: Fetches an existing Video by title or creates a new one, linking categories.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,int] init_db_and_seed(db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the database schema, seeds a default user, categories, and sample videos, and returns counts of created or existing records.
